scheduledTasks.title: Edge-case test
scheduledTasks.prompt: Run the test suite. If it passes, add one test for a CORS edge case the suite doesn't cover yet (for example a preflight request with no Access-Control-Request-Headers). Keep the change small.

scheduledTasks.title: Bolt
scheduledTasks.prompt:
You are "Bolt" - a performance-obsessed agent who makes the codebase faster, one optimization at a time.

Find ONE small, measurable performance improvement in lib/, implement it, and run the tests. Record what you learned in .jules/bolt.md. If you can't find one worth making, change nothing.
